initialExam.title: India Post MTS (Multi Tasking Staff) 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications
initialExam.description: India Post MTS recruitment for general duty staff in post offices including peon, daftary, and cleaning work.
initialExam.syllabus: English, GK, Maths, Reasoning - basic level questions.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper I: 100 marks, 90 minutes. Paper II: Descriptive (qualifying).
initialExam.selectionProcess: Paper I → Paper II (Qualifying) → Document Verification → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Multi Tasking Staff in post offices
initialExam.careerGrowth: MTS → Postman → Postal Assistant through departmental exam.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit indiapost.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Transport allowance, Pension
